title: Coming in 2027: Apple’s $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and switching on lights
hook_text: One thousand dollars for Apple's robot.
script:
Apple is developing a one thousand dollar home robot for twenty twenty-seven.
CEO John Ternus is leading this project to bring the device to your home.
The machine uses a robotic arm to handle FaceTime calls and switch on lights.
It features a roaming base designed to follow you around the house.
Ars Technica reports this device focuses on smart home control and video communication.
Would you pay one thousand dollars for a robot with such limited functionality?
